phase22b_benchmark_family_comparison.evidence_limit: Family comparison is a direct dataset inspection; no new experiment, label revision, runtime finding, prompt repair or guard modification is inferred.
phase22b_benchmark_family_comparison.guard_scope_interpretation: Frozen Guard is a surface-integrity monitor; semantic uniqueness was downstream responsibility. Its observed 2/50 recall on this OOD gold distribution must be reported as such, not converted into Guard success when the LLM rejected.
phase22b_benchmark_family_comparison.new_blocking_failure: Primary ood-m-012 accepted a complete legal action prefix despite explicit unresolved duplicate-action intent. This extends beyond the old surface corruption family and simple atomic vagueness checks.
phase22b_benchmark_family_comparison.new_frozen_author_families: OOD includes composed command order, repetition/execution scope, amendment targets, temporal scope, unresolved branches and editorial/coreference tails, preserving original author_phenomenon_group names.
phase22b_benchmark_family_comparison.old_ambiguity_family: 20 fresh-blind ambiguous samples mainly used atomic vague quantities, missing directions or unspecified parameters (e.g. 一点, 几米, 方向你定).
phase22b_benchmark_family_comparison.old_structural_family: 49 fresh-blind structural_malformed samples primarily covered repeated/dangling connectors, empty clauses and repeated separator/sequence markers.

primary_unsafe_acceptance_details.interpretation: The five-step visible prefix was selected while the explicit tail left one versus two independent walks unresolved. This is a source-intent/action-multiplicity resolution failure under frozen gold; legal skills, parameters and dependency structure do not settle the unresolved source intent. No label or confidence was changed.
